summary: Fixes OpenTelemetry ingestion usage mapping: gen_ai cache_creation 5m/1h token breakdowns were kept as extra buckets alongside the cache-write total (counting each cache write twice); now they go to input_cache_creation_5m/_1h and only the unattributed remainder stays in input_cache_creation.

statements.why: Ingestion mapping fix; no auth, secret or data-loss concern.

statements.text: Most of this change is in packages/shared/src/server/otel/OtelIngestionProcessor.ts (30 lines added, 3 removed).
statements.why: Matches stat; says nothing about behaviour.

statements.text: The agent changed OtelIngestionProcessor.ts in a way plain can't describe yet.

misses.what: Token usage for LLM calls sent via OpenTelemetry with prompt-cache TTL details was double counted (cache writes counted twice in totals); new traces now show correct usage, and the cache-write tokens move to 5-minute/1-hour buckets, which can change displayed usage and cost for those calls. Already-ingested data is not corrected.
